description:
Browse or search Workshop submissions. One page of submissions. Each carries `workshopid` (the Steam published-file id), `title`,
`author_steamid64`, `preview_image_url`, `submitted_at` (UTC ISO-8601, may be null), `accepted` and
`accepted_itemdefid` (the in-game item definition id when Facepunch accepted it - use it with
`/skins/{itemdefid}`), `target_item_tag`, `subscriptions` and `vote_score` (Steam's 0-1 score; both null
when Steam has not reported them). Same filters, ordering and cache as the /workshop page.

accepted.description: `yes` = only submissions Facepunch accepted into the game; `no` = only ones it has not.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the submission title.

sort.description: `newest` = most recently submitted first; `popular` = most subscribers first.

target.description: Only submissions for this target item, exactly as the Workshop tags it (e.g. `AK47`, `Garage Door`); `/workshop/targets` lists every value.

name: search_workshop
title: Browse or search Workshop submissions
